predictions: Aw, crap… one week after a stellar showing, I really flopped quite a bit last week. Pretty weak 13-10 last week, but I can at least take a bit of solace in the fact that SEVEN of my incorrect picks were decided by a single dart (five 13-11 outcomes, and two 12-12s). And I even had two teams add players (which I don't know until after the newsletter is sent out) who ended up making that small difference in two of those seven one-darters. Ugh. This is a tough game we play on this page. Anyway, this brings me to 48-21 (69.6% correct) for the season. Decent still.

Match of the week: (C Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ One Armed Bandits. The only two one-loss teams in C have only played twice each, so the gap behind these two undefeated teams feels larger than might have been expected. These two could be racing all season, and this first head-to-head pairing has thus become a monster matchup. I still feel like this race is Stumble Out's, so we'll stick with them, 15-9.

Match #2: (G Div.) The Neighborhood Dart Knights @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. Another matchup of undefeateds, but this time they're part of a trio. We Throw It has been dropping bombs on the newcomers so far, but the Dart Knights are anything but newcomers. No chance I'm hopping off the Dart Knight train just yet, so this is Knights, 16-8.

Match #3: (B Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Darty Minds. Show Me didn't have a couple key guys last week, so this isn't the undefeated matchup that I expected. It's still the top two teams in the division though, so this is still going to determine who leads B heading into week 5. Even though I think Darty might be missing a key weapon, they're still my pick to take this race (and also this match). DM, 13-11.

Match #4: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Runs with Corks. A slow week 1 singles start for Sofa is the only thing keeping this from being a pair of undefeateds also. I was all set to pick them for a while, but then the Corks drop a sledge on Possee last week! Gotta stay with Corks, 13-11.

Match #5: (E Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Ton 80 Proof. Ton 80 has split their last two dramatic weeks, so they sit one loss behind the Rangers. While the Rangers are indeed 2-0, they haven't exactly set anything on fire. I'll stay with Rangers, but I admit quite timidly, 13-11.

Match #6: (D Div.) Cheap Shots @ Hump Day! D sits as the only division without a winless team after only three weeks. But what it does have is FIVE 1-loss teams, and here the 1st and 5th of those get together. Maybe it's time for Hump Day to keep rolling? 14-10.

Match #7: (F Div.) Dart Side of the Moon @ Liquor Possee. Just last week, these teams were both 2-0. Then they both got mostly pounded (by a winless team in the case of Dart Side), and now the loser here is on an L-streak and falling off the pace. Possee?? 13-11.

Match #8: (B Div.) Iceman's @ Raging Bulls Eyes. Big win for the Ragers last week, while Iceman's nearly pulled one out without Page. The opportunities are all laid out in front of Raging, while the time is getting to be a "now" thing for Iceman's chances. Raging, 14-10.

Match #9: (E Div.) Irish Ton @ Village Idiots. Here are teams living in different worlds so far. The Irish crush or get crushed, while the Idiots take everything to the wire whether they win or lose. Despite the Idiots' losing record, I still see a minor run as possible. VI, 14-10.

Match #10: (G Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ Killer Dee's. This is pretty cool… the two brand new or nearly brand new teams facing off with a chance to sit at 0.500 a full month into the season. I think I have to go with the team that has won some DCkts already. Dee's, 15-9.
Match #11: (E Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Y.N.T.A. We've reached that time when I can write "somebody is guaranteed a first win" and have it not be only 0-1 or 0-2 teams. This has to be Machine, 16-8.
Match #12: (B Div.) Trippin Bulls @ Trips Are For Kids. This sounds like a match from LSD division. With For Kids coming off a solid win over Iceman's, there's no way I pick against them. 15-9.
And the remaining 11 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Ring of Elements 19, Serious? 5; Liver Alliance 17, Consistently Inconsistent 7; Lunatic Fringe 17, Matt's Tab 7.
B Division: Dart Attack 14, Double In, Uber Out 10.
C Division: Outlaws 13, Constantly 11; Darty Sanchez 13, Rif Raf 9.
D Division: Reload 14, Shooter McGavin 10; Menace 14, Duckas 10.
F Division: Shark Shooters 13, She Said 11; Rippin 13, Bangin 11.
G Division: Nein Mark 15, The Rock Bottoms 9.
